name: qnity-csl-dashboard
description: QNITY CSL Laboratory Renovation 2026 - Project Dashboard Portal

scripts.//build: prisma generate runs first because Vercel restores a cached node_modules and skips the @prisma/client postinstall that would otherwise generate it. Generation needs no database connection, so this is safe in mock mode. Migrations are NOT run here — see scripts/db-deploy.mjs and docs/DEPLOY-VERCEL.md.
scripts.//db:deploy: Applies prisma/migrations to DATABASE_URL. No-ops with a clear message when no database is configured, so it is safe to chain into any deploy command.
scripts.//db:check: Diagnoses the production database: DATA_SOURCE, pooled/direct URLs, connectivity, migration state and whether the baseline is seeded.
scripts.//seed: Destructive: clears the project graph and users, then writes the baseline. Refuses to run against a database that already holds data unless passed --force.
